# ActionScript declaration coverage

Generated by `python3 scripts/progress.py --write-reports`. Counting rules: [README.md](README.md).

**Working**: the main behavior from the Adobe reference runs and a linked test proves it. **Partial**: it runs, with the missing behavior named. **Missing**: no runtime path yet. **Needs review**: not yet classified. Statuses change only through test-backed reviews; this is not a Flash compatibility score. Last status review: 2026-11-05.

## Evidence rules

### B01 — Architectural absence of platform libraries

Bounded per-handler AS frontend exposes only its accepted core calls and small display proxy. No native Flash/AIR/Flex/component class library, project resolver/linker or generic VM is bundled. Authored NeoFlash geometry/events are not arbitrary callable Flash APIs. This is an architectural absence inference, not an individual execution test.

Architectural inference; declarations were not individually executed.

### C07 — Grouping and comments are parsed with bounded resource guards

Line/block comments and grouping are lexed/parsed; unclosed comments and excessive token/expression/statement nesting yield diagnostics. This is a syntactic subset assertion only.

Blocks, if/else, while/do-while, classic for, switch strict matching/fallthrough, break/continue are implemented. AS3 labels resolve only enclosing targets and do not cross function boundaries. ### P0-VISIBILITY-20261026T2353Z — Independent HTML5 acceptance: P0-VISIBILITY-20261026T2353Z

passes in verified boolean visibility scope

Boolean true/false only is accepted for AS2/AS3 authored MovieClip placements. Non-Boolean AS2 conversions have not been established against a Flash runtime. TextField and native Button visibility were not individually browser-tested; their shared proxy route is source-reviewed only. Root hiding, stale handles, symbol replacement and overlap click-through are supplemental Rust/Node checks, not additional browser acceptance claims. TextField.text, width and AS2 onEnterFrame assignment still fall through to custom fields in this snapshot; they remain open P0. XFL policy/identity and intrinsic changes present in this frozen snapshot were not independently accepted in this run.

- `as2:MovieClip.html#_visible` — **working**: Boolean true/false on authored MovieClip placements: pixels, pointer/semantic targets, hidden clocks/Load and preserved state. Other conversions and original Flash differential unverified.
- `AS3:property:flash/display/DisplayObject.html#visible` — **working**: Boolean true/false on authored MovieClip placements and child-local inherited visibility; does not certify every DisplayObject subclass or constructor.
- `as2:TextField.html#_visible` — **needs_review**: New shared visibility route makes the historical absence inference stale; dedicated TextField browser fixture still required.
- `as2:Button.html#_visible` — **needs_review**: New shared visibility route exists; native Button behavior/state and visibility need a dedicated browser fixture.

### AS2-FOUNDATION-COMPLETE-20261101 — Complete AS2 foundation areas 1-6 and adjacent Accessibility, Video, and loader APIs

Implements and verifies #initclip/#endinitclip, intrinsic declarations, MovieClip.beginBitmapFill, tellTarget, ifFrameLoaded, call, _level0/_levelN, variable.scroll/maxscroll, Accessibility and _accProps, Video typing and deblocking, MovieClipLoader.removeListener and load lifecycle callbacks, and checkPolicyFile validation across MovieClipLoader, Sound, and NetStream.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `as2:directives.html##initclip()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:directives.html##endinitclip()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:statements.html#intrinsic` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:MovieClip.html#beginBitmapFill()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_functions.html#tellTarget()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_functions.html#ifFrameLoaded()` — **partial**: Evaluates 1..=_totalframes, frame labels, and scene names on the current MovieClip timeline; self-contained HTML5 bundles preload all authored frames up front rather than progressive SWF frame streaming.
- `as2:global_functions.html#call()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_props.html#_level` — **partial**: _level0 resolves to the main publication root timeline independently of _lockroot across expressions, target paths, and eval(); _levelN (N >= 1) resolves to undefined because multi-SWF levels are outside single-document HTML5 exports.
- `as2:global_props.html#scroll` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_props.html#maxscroll` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.

- `as2:Video.html#class` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:Video.html#deblocking` — **partial**: Validates and stores integer 0..=5 on VideoState in shared Rust and resets on restart; browser HTML5 <video> decoders manage post-processing internally rather than applying Flash On2/Sorenson deblocking levels.
- `as2:MovieClipLoader.html#removeListener()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:MovieClipLoader.html#checkPolicyFile` — **partial**: Validates and stores Boolean checkPolicyFile state on MovieClipLoader instances; browser CORS replaces Flash crossdomain.xml policy-file fetches in HTML5.

### AS2-SERVICES-MATH-20261101 — AS2 global functions, device/network/system services, XMLSocket, and math-geometry promotions

Closes all 12 needs_review AS2 global functions and 58 missing Areas 7-8 declarations (Camera/Microphone encoder prefs, System/IME/security, LocalConnection allowDomain, FileReference dates, NetConnection.protocol, NetStream play2/getInfo/publish/send, remote SharedObject, XMLSocket) and promotes 124 verified Area 1 math/geometry entries to working.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `as2:Camera.html#bandwidth` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks bandwidth byte-rate preferences (default 16384); browser MediaStream preview does not run Flash Sorenson/VP6 upstream bitrate throttling.
- `as2:Camera.html#keyFrameInterval` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks keyframe interval preferences (1..=300, default 15); browser MediaStream preview has no Flash RTMP video encoder.
- `as2:Camera.html#loopback` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks boolean loopback preferences (default false); local HTML5 video preview does not simulate Flash software compression artifacts.
- `as2:Camera.html#quality` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks compression quality preferences (0..=100, default 0); browser MediaStream preview uses native camera tracks without Flash software frame encoding.
- `as2:Camera.html#setKeyFrameInterval()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates and stores keyframe intervals (1..=300); browser MediaStream preview does not run Flash RTMP keyframe encoding.
- `as2:Camera.html#setLoopback()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates and stores boolean loopback flags; browser camera preview renders native video frames without simulated Flash encoder compression.
- `as2:Camera.html#setQuality()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates and stores bandwidth (>= 0) and quality (0..=100); browser MediaStream preview does not run Flash RTMP video encoding.
- `as2:LocalConnection.html#event:allowDomain` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:LocalConnection.html#event:allowInsecureDomain` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:Microphone.html#codec` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture normalizes and reports NellyMoser/Speex codec names (default NellyMoser); Web Audio capture streams PCM locally without Flash RTMP audio encoding.
- `as2:Microphone.html#encodeQuality` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks Speex encodeQuality (0..=10, default 6); Web Audio capture does not run Flash Speex upstream encoding.
- `as2:Microphone.html#framesPerPacket` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture tracks Speex framesPerPacket (1..=16, default 2); Web Audio capture does not packetize RTMP audio frames.
- `as2:Microphone.html#setCodec()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates case-insensitive NellyMoser and Speex codec names; Web Audio capture streams local PCM without Flash RTMP codec encoding.
- `as2:Microphone.html#setEncodeQuality()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates and stores encodeQuality integers (0..=10); Web Audio capture does not run Flash Speex upstream encoding.
- `as2:Microphone.html#setFramesPerPacket()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Capture validates and stores framesPerPacket integers (1..=16); Web Audio capture does not packetize RTMP audio frames.
- `as2:NetConnection.html#protocol` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:NetStream.html#attachAudio()` — **partial**: Validates Microphone, false, or null sources and records stream attachment; HTML5 NetStream has no RTMP upstream audio publishing server.
- `as2:NetStream.html#attachVideo()` — **partial**: Validates Camera, false, or null sources and optional snapshotMilliseconds and records stream attachment; HTML5 NetStream has no RTMP upstream video publishing server.
- `as2:NetStream.html#event:onCuePoint` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:NetStream.html#event:onTextData` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:NetStream.html#event:onXMPData` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:NetStream.html#getInfo()` — **partial**: Returns an AS2 NetStream info snapshot with live bufferLength and loaded byte metrics; RTMP round-trip srtt and server bitrate counters report 0 in progressive HTTP playback.
- `as2:NetStream.html#liveDelay` — **partial**: Returns 0 for progressive HTTP/resource video streams; live RTMP server latency measurement is unavailable in HTML5.
- `as2:NetStream.html#maxPauseBufferTime` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Stream validates and stores maxPauseBufferTime (0..=3600s, default 30); browser HTMLVideoElement manages HTTP progressive pause buffering natively.
- `as2:NetStream.html#play2()` — **partial**: Validates stream transition options (streamName and optional start offset) and switches progressive media playback; RTMP dynamic bitrate server switching is unavailable.
- `as2:NetStream.html#publish()` — **partial**: Validates stream name and live/record/append mode (or false to unpublish) and asynchronously emits NetStream.Publish.BadName because HTML5 has no RTMP media server.
- `as2:NetStream.html#send()` — **partial**: Validates handler names and asynchronously dispatches data messages to stream callbacks (onCuePoint, onTextData, onXMPData, or custom handlers); RTMP upstream recording is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#close()` — **partial**: Disconnects a remote SharedObject peer session or flushes a local SharedObject; remote RTMP server channel teardown is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#connect()` — **partial**: Connects a remote SharedObject to an AS2 NetConnection and asynchronously dispatches initial onSync ([{code:'clear'}]); Flash Media Server RTMP sync is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#event:onStatus` — **partial**: Supports assigning and invoking onStatus callback handlers on AS2 SharedObject instances; remote FMS server error codes are not emitted locally.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#event:onSync` — **partial**: Dispatches initial onSync change lists when a remote SharedObject connects; multi-client RTMP server delta synchronization is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#getRemote()` — **partial**: Creates origin-scoped in-session remote SharedObject instances with validated name and remotePath; multi-client Flash Media Server RTMP persistence is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#send()` — **partial**: Validates handler names and asynchronously broadcasts messages across connected in-session remote SharedObject peers; multi-client RTMP server broadcast is unavailable.
- `as2:SharedObject.html#setFps()` — **partial**: Validates finite non-negative update rates on remote SharedObjects; Flash Media Server RTMP polling intervals are not used in browser memory.
- `as2:System.html#event:onStatus` — **partial**: Stores and resets the System.onStatus callback handler; browser services deliver status events to target listeners without Flash NetConnection/SharedObject global fallback bubbling.
- `as2:System.html#setClipboard()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:System.html#showSettings()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates settings tab IDs (0..=3) and notifies the host UI hook; browser site permission UI replaces Flash Player's embedded settings dialog.
- `as2:System/IME.html#doConversion()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform dispatches pending composition text to System.IME onIMEComposition listeners when enabled; browsers do not expose forced OS IME candidate conversion.
- `as2:System/IME.html#getConversionMode()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform reports the active IME conversion mode constant; browsers do not expose native OS IME mode inspection.
- `as2:System/IME.html#getEnabled()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform reports the tracked IME enabled state initialized from browser CompositionEvent support; OS-level IME state cannot be queried directly.
- `as2:System/IME.html#setCompositionString()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates and stores UTF-8 composition strings (up to 4 KiB) when enabled; browsers do not allow scripts to overwrite active OS IME preedit buffers.
- `as2:System/IME.html#setConversionMode()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates Flash IME mode constants and updates tracked state when enabled; browsers do not permit scripts to switch OS input method modes.
- `as2:System/IME.html#setEnabled()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates boolean state and toggles tracked IME availability; browsers do not permit scripts to enable or disable the user's OS IME.
- `as2:System/security.html#allowDomain()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates and records allowed domains; browser cross-origin access remains governed by standard CORS and origin isolation.
- `as2:System/security.html#allowInsecureDomain()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates and records allowed HTTP domains; browser mixed-content and CORS policies remain enforced by the user agent.
- `as2:System/security.html#loadPolicyFile()` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Platform validates and records HTTP(S) policy file URLs; browser networking uses standard CORS headers rather than Flash crossdomain.xml files.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#XMLSocket()` — **partial**: Constructs an AS2 XMLSocket backed by Rust ScriptAS2Connections session state; raw TCP socket transport requires a WebSocket bridge in browsers.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#class` — **partial**: Provides AS2 XMLSocket with Rust NUL-frame assembly, port >= 1024 validation, timeout, and XML/raw callbacks over WebSocket or injected transport; raw browser TCP sockets are unavailable.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#close()` — **partial**: Closes active WebSocket/host transport and clears Rust XMLSocket receive buffers; raw TCP half-close semantics are unavailable.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#connect()` — **partial**: Validates host (empty/null resolving to publication domain) and port (1024..=65535) in Rust and initiates WebSocket/host transport with connection timeout; port 843 TCP policy sockets are unavailable.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#event:onClose` — **partial**: Invokes onClose() when an open remote WebSocket connection closes unexpectedly.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#event:onConnect` — **partial**: Invokes onConnect(true|false) upon WebSocket handshake completion, error, or timeout; TCP crossdomain policy handshakes are not used.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#event:onData` — **partial**: Invokes onData(src) for each NUL-delimited UTF-8 frame reassembled in Rust and parses LegacyXML into onXML unless overridden.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#event:onXML` — **partial**: Invokes onXML(doc) with a parsed AS2 XML document from the default XMLSocket.prototype.onData handler.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#send()` — **partial**: Validates NUL-free UTF-8 payloads up to 256 KiB in Rust and transmits NUL-terminated frames over open WebSocket/host transport; raw unframed TCP sockets are unavailable.
- `as2:XMLSocket.html#timeout` — **partial**: Rust ScriptAS2Connections validates and stores non-negative integer connection timeouts in milliseconds (default 20000) enforced on pending WebSocket handshakes.
- `as2:flash/net/FileReference.html#creationDate` — **partial**: Returns a Date from browser File metadata (created timestamp or lastModified fallback) once a file is selected; Web File APIs do not expose distinct filesystem birth times.
- `as2:flash/net/FileReference.html#creator` — **partial**: Returns undefined on Web File selections because browser File objects do not expose classic macOS HFS four-character creator codes.
- `as2:global_functions.html#MMExecute()` — **partial**: Validates the JSFL command String and returns an empty string at runtime, matching standalone Flash Player behavior outside the Flash IDE authoring panel.
- `as2:global_functions.html#asfunction()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_functions.html#fscommand()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_functions.html#getURL()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.
- `as2:global_functions.html#loadMovie()` — **partial**: Resolves MovieClip instances or AS2 target paths and loads raster image resources via the shared Loader pipeline; external SWF binary loading and root replacement are unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#loadMovieNum()` — **partial**: Validates non-negative integer levels and reports an explicit HTML5 boundary diagnostic because multi-SWF _level1+ stacks and _level0 root replacement are unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#print()` — **partial**: Validates target MovieClip and bmovie/bmax/bframe bounding mode and renders bitmap print pages via PrintJob browser preview; multi-frame #p vector spooling is unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#printAsBitmap()` — **partial**: Validates target MovieClip and bmovie/bmax/bframe bounding mode and renders bitmap print pages via PrintJob browser preview; multi-frame #p frame selection is unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#printAsBitmapNum()` — **partial**: Validates level 0 and bmovie/bmax/bframe bounding mode and renders stage bitmap pages via PrintJob browser preview; multi-SWF levels above 0 are unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#printNum()` — **partial**: Validates level 0 and bmovie/bmax/bframe bounding mode and renders stage print pages via PrintJob browser preview; levels above 0 and vector spooling are unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#unloadMovie()` — **partial**: Resolves MovieClip instances or AS2 target paths and unloads loaded image content via the shared Loader pipeline; external SWF binary unloading and root replacement are unavailable.
- `as2:global_functions.html#unloadMovieNum()` — **partial**: Validates non-negative integer levels and reports an explicit HTML5 boundary diagnostic because multi-SWF _level1+ stacks and _level0 root replacement are unavailable.

### AS2-CONFORMANCE-LEGACY-GRAPHICS-TEXT-20261101 — AS2 core language, legacy events/operators, XML/LoadVars, BitmapData/filters and text conformance

Closes AS1/AS2 legacy on/onClipEvent handlers, Flash 4 operators and property constants, Sound(target), Number radix formatting, Object primitive boxing, instanceof, XML.send POST, and BitmapData.loadBitmap linkage; verifies core language, XML/LoadVars, Selection/timers, Color, BitmapData, nine filters, TextFormat, StyleSheet, TextSnapshot, and TextField.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

### AS3-FOUNDATION-GEOM3D-GRAPHICS-TEXT-20261101 — AS3 foundation Batch 4: 3D geometry, AMF aliases, legacy XML, display/stage, graphics data and text

Implements Matrix3D decompose/recompose/interpolate/pointAt, Orientation3D, Utils3D.pointTowards, flash.errors, AMF class aliases, flash.xml DOM, DisplayObject scale9Grid/lifecycle events, Stage/Sprite/Container methods, MouseCursorData, IGraphicsData/drawTriangles/lineBitmapStyle, BitmapData histogram/drawWithQuality, TextField htmlText/styleSheet and StaticText/TextSnapshot.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `AS3:function:flash/net/package.html#navigateToURL()` — **partial**: Validates URLRequest and navigates through the browser window host; Flash cross-domain policy files do not apply in HTML5.
- `AS3:function:flash/net/package.html#sendToURL()` — **partial**: Validates URLRequest and dispatches an asynchronous browser fetch/beacon request subject to standard CORS rules.

### AS3-AIR-DESKTOP-FS-DATA-20261101 — AS3 AIR virtual filesystem, relational SQL engine, desktop/windowing, and events

Implements the shared Rust AirRuntime (virtual AIR filesystem with read-only app:/ roots, EncryptedLocalStore, AIR 32.0 descriptor XML, and relational SQLite-compatible engine), WASM AirKernel, web/air.js host adapters, and AS3 compiler builtins/IFilePromise contracts across flash.filesystem, flash.data, flash.desktop, flash.display, flash.events, and companion AIR packages.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

### AS3-NET-NAVIGATE-20261102 — AS3 flash.net.navigateToURL browser navigation and POST form dispatch

Promotes flash.net.navigateToURL(request, window) from partial to working: validates safe HTTP(S), relative and mailto: URLs, blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: schemes, supports _self/_blank/_parent/_top and named window targets, and submits POST requests via hidden form or query parameters.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `AS3:function:flash/net/package.html#navigateToURL()` — **working**: Main contract covered by the listed tests.

Evidence: [crates/neoflash-script/tests/project.rs](../../crates/neoflash-script/tests/project.rs), [web/tests/runtime.test.cjs](../../web/tests/runtime.test.cjs)

### AS3-AREAS1TO7-20261102 — AS3 Areas 1-6 and Area 7 flash.media full Working promotion (437 declarations)

Implements standalone LZMA ByteArray compression, full AS3 language/operator/directive/Proxy/E4X surface, multi-run TextField formatting and HTML/CSS/justify/inline-image layout, BitmapData 15-BlendMode draw and DisplacementMapFilter, InteractiveObject/Stage events, and Rust-backed flash.media Sound/SoundChannel/SoundTransform/SoundMixer/ID3Info/Video.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

### AS3-AREA8-NET-SYS-GLOB-20261102 — AS3 Area 8 network, system, globalization, concurrency, crypto, DRM, sampler and security

Implements and verifies the 964 AS3 Area 8 declarations across flash.concurrent, flash.crypto, flash.desktop, flash.external, flash.globalization, flash.media, flash.net, flash.net.drm, flash.printing, flash.profiler, flash.sampler, flash.security, flash.sensors, flash.system and flash.utils in the shared Rust As3NetSysKernel, WASM bridge, compiler and browser host.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

### AS3-FTE-3D-SHADERS-20261102 — AS3 Area 8 FTE, IME, Stage3D, Pixel Bender shaders, and 3D display runtime

Implements and verifies 578 AS3 declarations across Flash Text Engine (flash.text.engine.*), IME (flash.text.ime.*), Stage3D/Context3D AGAL software rasterizer (flash.display3D.*), Pixel Bender shaders (Shader/ShaderData/ShaderParameter/ShaderInput/ShaderJob/ShaderFilter/GraphicsShaderFill), 3D DisplayObject/Transform, Loader/LoaderInfo, MorphShape, and AVM1Movie.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `AS3:class:flash/display/AVM1Movie.html#` — **working**: 3D DisplayObject/Transform projections, Stage3D slots, MorphShape, and AVM1Movie runtime in as3_fte_3d.rs + web/as3-fte-3d.js verified in f7a8e0f.

### AS3-STATUS-CALIBRATION-A01-20261102 — Calibrate AS3 Flash Player and AIR simulated/bounded APIs from working to partial (A-01)

Demotes in-memory desktop, OS process, raw socket, DRM, P2P RTMFP, worker concurrency, sampler, Stage3D/Pixel Bender, FTE and hardware capture simulations from working to partial with explicit notes naming browser and runtime boundaries.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `AS3:class:flash/accessibility/Accessibility.html#` — **partial**: Updates semantic ARIA overlay state in the HTML5 host; native MSAA/UIA screen-reader COM interfaces are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/accessibility/AccessibilityImplementation.html#` — **partial**: Updates semantic ARIA overlay state in the HTML5 host; native MSAA/UIA screen-reader COM interfaces are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/accessibility/AccessibilityProperties.html#` — **partial**: Updates semantic ARIA overlay state in the HTML5 host; native MSAA/UIA screen-reader COM interfaces are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/concurrent/Condition.html#` — **partial**: Simulates worker lifecycle, message channels and mutex/condition state in the runtime arena; isolated multi-threaded AVM2 bytecode workers are not spawned.
- `AS3:class:flash/concurrent/Mutex.html#` — **partial**: Simulates worker lifecycle, message channels and mutex/condition state in the runtime arena; isolated multi-threaded AVM2 bytecode workers are not spawned.
- `AS3:class:flash/data/SQLColumnNameStyle.html#` — **partial**: Operates against the in-memory AirFileSystem (`app:/` and `app-storage:/`) and single-page HTML5 stage; native OS multi-window chrome, system tray/dock icons and host filesystem dialogs outside the sandbox are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/desktop/Clipboard.html#` — **partial**: Runs against the bounded HTML5/Rust runtime simulation; native Flash Player OS/plugin services are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/desktop/ClipboardFormats.html#` — **partial**: Runs against the bounded HTML5/Rust runtime simulation; native Flash Player OS/plugin services are simulated.
- `AS3:class:flash/desktop/ClipboardTransferMode.html#` — **partial**: Runs against the bounded HTML5/Rust runtime simulation; native Flash Player OS/plugin services are simulated.

- `AS3:class:flash/desktop/NativeProcess.html#` — **partial**: Simulated through an in-memory process table and synthetic stdio streams in HTML5; spawning host OS child processes is not available in the browser sandbox.
- `AS3:class:flash/desktop/NativeProcessStartupInfo.html#` — **partial**: Simulated through an in-memory process table and synthetic stdio streams in HTML5; spawning host OS child processes is not available in the browser sandbox.

### AS2-STATUS-CALIBRATION-A01-20261102 — Calibrate AS2 simulated/bounded Player APIs from working to partial (A-01)

Demotes AS2 live RTMP streaming, hardware Camera/Microphone capture, XMLSocket, LocalConnection, remote SharedObject, PrintJob, FileReference, IME and external _levelN SWF loading from working to partial with explicit limitation notes.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

### AS3-EVIDENCE-CALIBRATION-20261105 — Correct reflection, media and authored-source mask coverage

Source reflection and volume-only video transforms remain partial; displayed-frame-rate measurement is missing. Cached masks preserve dynamic alpha sources but lose authored gradients or reject authored bitmaps. Positive shared tests and targeted WASM/browser probes distinguish these boundaries.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `AS3:function:flash/utils/package.html#describeType()` — **partial**: Public ordinary AS3 source classes are described; native-base, interface and rest-signature descriptions remain unsupported.
- `AS3:function:flash/utils/package.html#getQualifiedClassName()` — **partial**: Source-class and selected primitive/class names work; primitive numeric values and native display instances diagnose instead of returning their qualified names.
- `AS3:function:flash/utils/package.html#getQualifiedSuperclassName()` — **partial**: Source-class and selected built-in superclass names work; primitive numeric values and native display instances are unsupported.
- `AS3:property:flash/net/NetStream.html#currentFPS` — **missing**: Displayed-frame-rate measurement is unimplemented; the getter echoes the requested receiveVideoFPS value while playing, including before any frame is decoded.
- `AS3:property:flash/net/NetStream.html#soundTransform` — **partial**: Volume is connected to playback; nonzero stereo pan is rejected and stereo matrix settings are not applied.
- `AS3:property:flash/display/DisplayObject.html#mask` — **partial**: Vector and cached dynamic gradient/bitmap masks work; cached authored gradient masks lose their opacity ramp, and authored bitmap sources are rejected.

### AS2-MASK-SOURCES-20261105 — Preserve authored gradient and bitmap alpha in animated masks

Cached authored gradients and decoded PNG sources share the dynamic alpha path, including mixed/nested transforms, animated sources and Restart. Geometry defaults remain unchanged. Text/video, fully scripted mask-of-mask graphs and cache/error edge behavior remain bounded.

Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.

- `as2:MovieClip.html#setMask()` — **partial**: Authored/dynamic gradient, PNG and mixed animated sources preserve cached alpha. Text/video and fully scripted masked-source graphs remain unsupported; filter-only cache downgrade remains limited. String target paths and raw-host-error catch compatibility remain unsupported.
